data.title: Record CLAUDE.md's decisions in the journal
data.description: search cannot find what is not in the journal: 'why are events append-only' returned Lean Canvas and a migration task, because the decision lives only in CLAUDE.md and in ADRs on the owner's disk (KAD-56). Record the five from 'Decisions with a reason behind them', and the two boundaries whose reason CLAUDE.md states, as decision events - with the reason as written there and the alternative it names as rejected. Nothing invented: a rule without a stated reason stays out.
